QuestInfo.name: First Greeting with Anne, the Town Resident
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p229#, the town clerk, is looking for someone to help with their work. Let's go check out #p235# in front of #m10001007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p229#, the town clerk, asked me to greet #b#p224##k, a resident of the town. Since I've become a resident here too, greeting the townspeople is a given, right?\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I greeted #p224#, a resident of #m10001000#. I have a feeling we're going to get along great!

0.0: "Since you've become a resident of #m10001000#, it would be a good idea to go greet the people here. As it happens, I've been wondering how #p224# is doing lately, so please go say hello to #p224#.\r\n- #p229#"

1.0: H-hello, I'm #p224#. But my mom told me I shouldn't talk to strangers... Wait, you're not a stranger, you live in #m10001000#?
1.1: Um... okay then, I think it's alright. My mom told me that all the grown-ups in #m10001000# are good people.

level.0: But you... your level seems a bit too low, doesn't it?
